# DESI MUCHADS

> DESI MUCHADS (Desi Muchads Digital LLP) is an India-based performance marketing, Meta & Google Ads, Quick Commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart), Branding, and Next.js Website Development agency headquartered in Hosapalaya, Bengaluru (560068).

Contact: Rahul Datta (CEO), Brinta Deb (CTO), Omkar Dutta (CFO) · Phone: +91 9180252831 · Email: [thedesimuchads@gmail.com](mailto:thedesimuchads@gmail.com)

## Core Agency Pages
- [Home](https://desimuchads.in/): Agency overview, interactive 3D showcase, custom quote builder, and orbital tech stack.
- [Services & Capabilities](https://desimuchads.in/services): All Meta & Google Ads, Social Media Management, Website Development, Branding, E-Commerce, and Quick Commerce disciplines.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://desimuchads.in/work): 50+ delivered D2C, Quick Commerce, SaaS, and hospitality builds with verified ROAS outcomes.
- [About & Leadership](https://desimuchads.in/about): Leadership profiles, agency thesis, and Net Contribution Margin methodology.
- [Request Quote & Book Strategy Session](https://desimuchads.in/contact): Direct consultation scheduling and custom quotation dispatch.

## Service Disciplines
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://desimuchads.in/services/meta-google-ads): Meta Advantage+, Google Search & Performance Max, creative testing loops, and server-side CAPI attribution.
- [Social Media Services](https://desimuchads.in/services/social-media): Viral short-form video hooks, cultural storytelling, and retention editing.
- [Website Development](https://desimuchads.in/services/web-development): Sub-second Next.js web platforms, custom motion choreography, and edge deployment.
- [Branding & Visual Identity](https://desimuchads.in/services/branding): Logo marks, monograms, typography systems, and comprehensive Brand Guidelines books.
- [E-Commerce & Shopify CRO](https://desimuchads.in/services/ecommerce-services): Conversion-engineered storefronts, bundle AOV lifts, and checkout optimization.
- [Quick Commerce Growth](https://desimuchads.in/services/quick-commerce): Dark store availability telemetry, keyword share-of-voice, and ad bidding on Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart.
- [Packaging & Label Production](https://desimuchads.in/services/packaging-label): Tactile packaging architecture, 3D mockups, and retail shelf differentiation.
